title: Year 11 Physics Module 4 – Electricity and Magnetism
description: A fast-recall review of NSW Year 11 Physics Module 4. Questions use short answers and avoid multi-step calculations or extended writing.
author: Generated with Classroom Jeopardy Quiz Maker

questions.prompt: What are the two types of electric charge?
Do like electric charges attract or repel?
Do opposite electric charges attract or repel?
What negatively charged particle can move between atoms in many materials?
What principle states that total electric charge is conserved in an isolated system?
What region around a charged object can exert an electric force on another charge?
Electric field lines point away from which type of charge?
Electric field lines point towards which type of charge?
What do closely spaced electric field lines indicate about field strength?
questions.answer: A stronger electric field. Accept: stronger field.

questions.prompt: What force acts between electrically charged objects without direct contact?
What quantity describes the rate of flow of electric charge?
What SI unit is used for electric current?
questions.answer: The ampere. Accept: amp or A.

questions.prompt: What quantity measures electric potential difference between two points?
What SI unit is used for electrical resistance?
What law links voltage, current and resistance in an ohmic conductor?
In which type of circuit is there only one path for current?
In which type of circuit are there multiple branches for current?
In a series circuit, is the current the same or different through each component?
In a parallel circuit, is the voltage across each branch the same or different?
Adding another resistor in series causes the total resistance to increase or decrease?
What are the two poles of a magnet called?
Do like magnetic poles attract or repel?
What region around a magnet can exert a magnetic force?
What produces a magnetic field around a straight wire?
What device becomes a magnet when electric current flows through a coil of wire?

finalRound.prompt: What moving quantity produces a magnetic field?
finalRound.answer: Electric charge. Accept: moving electric charge or electric current.
